description:
Precondition step 1-5 from PKIX-9vnx.9.2's recorded plan (Mark, 2026-05-12). Today pkix-lint-cabf::cabf_tls_br::CabfTlsBrProfile carries both impl Profile and impl LintProfile, and delegates path-policy fields to pkix_profiles_cabf::WebPkiProfile. This puts a Profile-shaped type in a -lint- crate and creates the edge pkix-lint-cabf -> pkix-profiles-cabf that blocks the inverse edge needed by PKIX-9vnx.9.2 (pkix-profiles-cabf -> pkix-lint-cabf for WebPkiProfile::lints()).

Architectural invariant Mark recorded: Profile types live in -profiles / -profiles-cabf crates; Lint types live in -lint / -lint-cabf crates. Dep flow: -profiles* -> -lint*.

## Scope

1. Delete pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br::CabfTlsBrProfile. Its impl Profile content is already covered by pkix_profiles_cabf::WebPkiProfile.
2. Move the existing impl LintProfile (which returned 6 Lints) to live on WebPkiProfile in pkix-profiles-cabf — this is the core of the refactor.
3. Make each individual Lint constructor pub in pkix-lint-cabf so pkix-profiles-cabf can pull them. Today they may be private struct types; surface them as zero-arg pub constructors (e.g. pub fn sha1_signature_lint() -> Box<dyn Lint>) or as pub structs with a pub fn new(). Either is acceptable; pick the smaller surface.
4. Drop pkix-profiles-cabf from pkix-lint-cabf's [dependencies] (no longer needed once WebPkiProfile reference goes away).
5. Add pkix-lint + pkix-lint-cabf to pkix-profiles-cabf's [dependencies].
6. Update call sites:
   - pkix-difftest/src/lint_oracles/pkix_lint_cabf.rs (currently uses CabfTlsBrProfile.lint_runner()) -> replace with WebPkiProfile.lint_runner().
   - pkix-lint-cabf/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs (the 'CabfTlsBrProfile integration — LintProfile impl' section, ~3 test fns) -> either delete (if covered by new pkix-profiles-cabf tests) or move to pkix-profiles-cabf/tests/.

## Acceptance

- cargo check --workspace --all-features clean (no dep cycle)
- cargo test --workspace --all-features clean
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean
- CabfTlsBrProfile no longer exists in pkix-lint-cabf source
- WebPkiProfile.lint_runner() returns the same 6 lints CabfTlsBrProfile.lint_runner() returned (pin by lint id list in a new test)
- CHANGELOG entries in both pkix-lint-cabf (breaking: removed type) and pkix-profiles-cabf (additive: LintProfile impl)

## Out of scope (separate beads)

- CabfSmimeBrProfile / CabfCsBrProfile — do not exist yet. When they do, the same pattern applies.
- The five check_*_shape aliases in pkix-profiles / pkix-profiles-cabf — that is PKIX-9vnx.9.2's own work, blocked on this bead.
- New RFC-conformance lints in pkix-lint — that is PKIX-9vnx.9.2.1 (also blocked on this).

## Why a sub-bead

PKIX-9vnx.9.2's recorded plan separates the cycle-break (steps 1-5) from the alias work (steps 6-8). Mark wrote 'Steps 1-5 are the cycle-break refactor (precondition). Steps 6-8 are this bead's original scope. Steps can ship as one PR or as two sequential PRs; the cycle break stands alone if separated.' Separating gives the refactor its own review surface.
title: Cycle-break: move CabfTlsBrProfile from pkix-lint-cabf into pkix-profiles-cabf (consolidate with WebPkiProfile)
